entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: label_replace requires exactly five arguments; labelReplaceAttributes is called only after the parser Call has been identified. Since cerberus issue #2449, lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp joins lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram and lowerLabelReplace as a third caller, but its own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer re-runs the identical `len(call.Args) != 5` check on the same parser Call before ever calling this function, so the claim is unaffected by the new caller. Since cerberus issue #2528, lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogramDroppingShape joins as a fourth caller, and likewise only reaches this function after its own labelCallOverExpHistogramDroppingShape recognizer has re-run the identical arity check, so the claim is unaffected by it either.
